hero.headline: I didn't describe the job. I've been doing it.
hero.subline: FlightCast's Support Engineer debugs real TypeScript/Next.js bugs and stays human with the customers who hit them. As a solo founder I'm both the engineer and the entire support team for my own production SaaS — this page maps your job description to work that's already shipped.

fitMap.theirNeed: Most customer issues are actual bugs — you want first-line debugging in TypeScript/Next.js from someone who talks to customers like an engineer, not a script.
fitMap.myProof: I'm the only support engineer my own products have. mnemix.ai runs on TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers and Supabase; Baylio ships React 19 + tRPC; dockerfile.ai ships Next.js 15. When something breaks there's no one to escalate to: I read the logs, find the root cause, ship the fix, and explain it to the affected user in plain English. That loop is my normal day, not an aspiration.

fitMap.theirNeed: Turn recurring tickets into product improvements and documentation — including docs that train the AI support chat.
fitMap.myProof: Verified, written-up examples from my own systems: an AI pipeline emitting empty text that violated OpenAI's embedding-API contract two layers downstream (traced, fixed, documented); a double-reservation billing bug; a cross-tenant idempotency-scope bug; and a runbook defining safe AI-agent behavior on ambiguous identity — documentation written to train the AI, not just the humans.

fitMap.theirNeed: AI-native product intuition — knowing how AI features fail in the wild and how to guardrail them.
fitMap.myProof: I operate a multi-agent fleet daily under a written governance doctrine: agents decide from evidence, log every decision with its rollback path, adversarially review each other's work, and ship behind kill switches and caps. I don't just use AI features — I run them in production and know exactly where they break.

fitMap.theirNeed: Creator empathy — the user you're supporting publishes, clips, and lives in analytics.
fitMap.myProof: I publish my own content across YouTube, X, LinkedIn and Instagram, and I've built automation pipelines for creators and agencies — so I've personally felt the workflow FlightCast exists to fix.
